fields.name: Minimum Required Version
fields.description: App version below this threshold will trigger mandatory Force Update (e.g. 1.0.0)

fields.name: Latest Available Version
fields.description: Latest release version on App Store (e.g. 2.1.0)

fields.name: App Store URL
fields.description: Direct link to App Store or TestFlight

fields.name: Maintenance Mode
fields.description: When true, blocks user access and shows maintenance notice

fields.name: Dialog Title
fields.description: Custom title for update or maintenance dialog

fields.name: Release Notes (What's New)
fields.description: Bullet points or newline-separated changelog items
